title: Counit formula for the inverse tensor–Hom adjunction chain
statement:
Fix the scheme and four coefficient-stage conventions of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], and let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes with the exceptional adjunction of [fix-prop-adjunctions]. Let $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ and $N\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$. Use the derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the restricted tensor–Hom adjunction [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-adjunctions], and projection isomorphism [fix-prop-projection-formula], with the projection map of [def-exchange-projection]. Put
$$C=Rf_!M,\quad L_N=R\mathcal Hom_X(M,Rf^!N),\quad A_N=Rf_*L_N,\quad B_N=R\mathcal Hom_Y(C,N).$$
Write $\varepsilon_{L_N}:Lf^*A_N\to L_N$ and $\mu_N:Rf_!Rf^!N\to N$ for the ordinary and exceptional counits, and $P_T:C\otimes^LT\to Rf_!(M\otimes^LLf^*T)$ for projection. Define
$$p_N=\mu_N\circ Rf_!\bigl(\operatorname{ev}_{M,Rf^!N}\circ(1_M\otimes\varepsilon_{L_N})\bigr)\circ P_{A_N}.$$
For every $T\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$ and $t:T\to A_N$, the composite Hom bijection
$$\Phi_T^N:\operatorname{Hom}_Y(T,A_N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_X(Lf^*T,L_N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_X(M\otimes^LLf^*T,Rf^!N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_Y(Rf_!(M\otimes^LLf^*T),N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_Y(C\otimes^LT,N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_Y(T,B_N)$$
satisfies $\Phi_T^N(t)=\operatorname{curry}(p_N)\circ t$. Here the fourth bijection precomposes with $P_T$, and currying/evaluation use the chosen tensor–Hom adjunction as in [lem-pod-closed-uncurry-laws]. These formulas are natural in both $T$ and $N$. Integral operations are completed; field operations use rationalization and common finite stages.

source.place: Step 1, the Hom chain read from right to left; explicit counit representative and naturality

proof.text: Work in the chosen coefficient-stage categories of the statement. First the domains. The supplied finite-Tor exceptional adjunction of [fix-prop-adjunctions](2) puts $C=Rf_!M$ and $Rf^!N$ in their finite-Tor categories. At finite coefficients [thm-sf-ctf-stability](i)–(iii) put $Lf^*T$, $M\otimes^LLf^*T$, $L_N=R\mathcal Hom_X(M,Rf^!N)$, $B_N=R\mathcal Hom_Y(C,N)$ and $A_N=Rf_*L_N$ in $D^b_{ctf}$. Integrally, clause (vii) gives $D^b_c=D^b_{ctf}$ and internal-Hom preservation, the completed pullback and tensor preserve $D^b_c$ by [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and [lem-sf-integral-direct-image-constructible] puts $A_N$ in $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$; the coefficient-passage clause of (vii) gives the same memberships at $E$ and $\Qlb$. In particular $A_N$ is a legitimate second input of the projection map $P_{A_N}$ in $p_N$. On these objects the ordinary adjunction of [fix-prop-adjunctions](1) and the supplied exceptional adjunction give the first and third bijections; the restricted tensor–Hom adjunction [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-adjunctions] named in the statement, in the chosen form with $M$ (resp. $C$) as left tensor factor, gives the second and fifth. The projection isomorphism [fix-prop-projection-formula], at $(M,T)$, gives the fourth by precomposition with $P_T$, in precisely the direction in the statement. Hence all five maps are bijections. The argument is internal to the supplied operations at each stage: integral pullback and tensor are completed, the field operations are the specified rationalized/common-stage ones, and no reduction of a rational object to finite coefficients is used.

source.place: Step 1, domains and directions in the reversed Hom chain

proof.text:
Fix $t:T\to A_N$ and put $q_N=\operatorname{ev}_{M,Rf^!N}\circ(1_M\otimes\varepsilon_{L_N})$, so $q_N:M\otimes^LLf^*A_N\to Rf^!N$. Apply the inverse-adjunction formula $\Psi^{-1}(b)=\varepsilon\circ F(b)$ from [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection] to $Lf^*\dashv Rf_*$: the first bijection sends $t$ to $\varepsilon_{L_N}\circ Lf^*t$. The evaluation formula in [lem-pod-closed-uncurry-laws] sends this to
$$v_t=\operatorname{ev}_{M,Rf^!N}\circ(1_M\otimes(\varepsilon_{L_N}\circ Lf^*t))=q_N\circ(1_M\otimes Lf^*t).$$
The equality is tensor functoriality and associativity of composition.

source.place: Step 1, first two arrows of the reversed chain, counit and evaluation

proof.text:
The same inverse-adjunction formula [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection], now for $Rf_!\dashv Rf^!$, sends $v_t$ to $\mu_N\circ Rf_!(v_t)$. Thus after the fourth bijection the map is $w_t=\mu_N\circ Rf_!(v_t)\circ P_T$. Naturality in the second input of [fix-prop-projection-formula], applied to $t:T\to A_N$, says
$$Rf_!(1_M\otimes Lf^*t)\circ P_T=P_{A_N}\circ(1_C\otimes t).$$
Substitute the expression for $v_t$ from step 2 and use functoriality of $Rf_!$ to obtain
$$w_t=\mu_N\circ Rf_!(q_N)\circ P_{A_N}\circ(1_C\otimes t)=p_N\circ(1_C\otimes t).$$

source.place: Step 1, exceptional counit and projection naturality in the reversed chain

proof.text:
Set $k_N=\operatorname{curry}(p_N):A_N\to B_N$. By [lem-pod-closed-uncurry-laws], $\operatorname{uncurry}(k_N)=p_N$ and
$$\operatorname{uncurry}(k_N\circ t)=\operatorname{uncurry}(k_N)\circ(1_C\otimes t)=p_N\circ(1_C\otimes t)=w_t.$$
The last bijection of the chain is currying. Since uncurry is a bijection, it follows that $\Phi_T^N(t)=k_N\circ t$, which is the asserted formula.

source.place: Step 1, final currying; the representing counit composite

proof.text:
For $s:T'\to T$, the formula just proved gives
$$\Phi_{T'}^N(t\circ s)=k_N\circ t\circ s=\Phi_T^N(t)\circ s.$$
Before currying the corresponding identity is $w_{t\circ s}=w_t\circ(1_C\otimes s)$, by the formula of step 3 and tensor functoriality. These equations give naturality in $T$, both for the uncurried formula and for the displayed Hom bijection.

source.place: Step 1, naturality in the test object

proof.text:
For $r:N\to N'$, put $h=R\mathcal Hom_X(M,Rf^!r):L_N\to L_{N'}$, $a=Rf_*h:A_N\to A_{N'}$, and $b=R\mathcal Hom_Y(C,r):B_N\to B_{N'}$. Counit naturality [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection] gives
$$\varepsilon_{L_{N'}}\circ Lf^*a=h\circ\varepsilon_{L_N},\qquad \mu_{N'}\circ Rf_!Rf^!r=r\circ\mu_N.$$
Naturality in the target of the chosen tensor–Hom bijection [lem-pod-closed-uncurry-laws], applied to the identity of $L_N$, gives evaluation naturality
$$\operatorname{ev}_{M,Rf^!N'}\circ(1_M\otimes h)=Rf^!r\circ\operatorname{ev}_{M,Rf^!N}.$$
Substitution yields $q_{N'}\circ(1_M\otimes Lf^*a)=Rf^!r\circ q_N$. Applying $Rf_!$, using the exceptional-counit equation and projection naturality [fix-prop-projection-formula] at $a$, gives
$$p_{N'}\circ(1_C\otimes a)=r\circ p_N.$$
Currying this equality, using naturality in source and target of the chosen adjunction [lem-pod-closed-uncurry-laws], gives $k_{N'}\circ a=b\circ k_N$. Composing with $t$ proves $\Phi_T^{N'}(a\circ t)=b\circ\Phi_T^N(t)$. This proves naturality in $N$; all equations use the actual natural transformations at the chosen coefficient stage.
